result.topic_en: Notes on the addition theorems of elliptic integrals: integrals of the form ∫z^n√f(z)dz with quartic or cubic f, the addition theorem for arcsin derived from a symmetric biquadratic relation F(x,y)=0 solving the differential equation dx/√R(x) = dy/√R(y), and the reduction to Jacobi's sin am, cos am, Δ am; the top left contains some combinatorial index calculations.
